nodes.definition: Maintain the ledger that tells a commission business whether its reputation is compounding, and read it on a regular cycle. Every opportunity is source-tagged at creation - referred by a named past customer, arrived from a public review or search, or bought through a paid channel - and every completed install is tracked forward so the seller can see what a cohort of finished jobs produced in introductions, appointments, and eventually installed deals over the following periods. Read alongside the cancellation causes, the partner scorecard, the complaint count, and the review record, the ledger answers the questions that decide the next year: is the referred share of installed deals rising or falling, which partner's jobs produce advocacy and which produce silence, and how long after activation referrals actually arrive. Because the lag is long, the ledger is read as a trend across periods rather than a monthly verdict, and it is the instrument that keeps reputation from being an article of faith.

included: source tagging at opportunity creation
cohort tracking of completed installs into later referred pipeline
joint reading with cancellation causes, partner scorecard, complaints, and reviews
excluded: overall pipeline conversion modelling and channel cost accounting, which belong to the market-models and lead-economics knowledge base
publishing any referral-yield figure as a market benchmark rather than as this book's own measurement

pros.claim: Cohort tracking makes the delayed payoff of good post-sale work visible, which is what keeps the discipline alive when it costs money today
pros.example: installs from an earlier period show a rising count of introductions arriving after activation, justifying the closeout work that produced them

cons.claim: The measurement lag is long enough that a practice change cannot be evaluated for several periods, so the ledger guides slowly
cons.example: a closeout improvement made this season cannot be judged on referred installs until well after the next selling cycle

failure_modes: leaving source tags blank or backfilling them from memory
reading a single slow month as evidence that referrals do not work
counting introductions as pipeline without tracking whether they became installed deals
acceptance_tests: every opportunity in the pipeline carries a source tag set at creation, with referred opportunities naming the referring customer where consent allows
a cohort view exists linking completed installs to the introductions and installed deals they later produced, refreshed on the stated cycle
revisit_triggers: the referred share of installed deals moves materially between periods
a partner change or market entry resets the installed base the ledger is measuring

base.update_signal: each additional period of cohort data, which either confirms or overturns the current read of how much pipeline the installed base is generating

edges.why_related: standing by the homeowner after signature is only justified as an operating cost once reputation is named as the asset the business is actually accumulating
staying the homeowner's contact forces an explicit line between the questions the seller may answer and those that belong to the licence holder
knowing which obligations sit with the installer determines which of its capabilities must be scored before a partnership is entered
the criteria model states which workmanship signals matter, which is what the evidence gathering then goes out to observe
schedule behaviour is a scored criterion, so the cohort cycle-time read is commissioned by the criteria model rather than done ad hoc
survival and payment behaviour are criteria whose evidence must be gathered before the partnership rather than after the first missed statement
the commercial terms are one of the scored criteria and cannot be scored without a clause-level reading of the executed agreement
exclusivity, territory, termination, and in-flight treatment clauses decide how much pipeline may be concentrated and what an exit will cost
the pre-partnership quality evidence becomes the baseline the ongoing scorecard measures drift against
the handoff packet can only assign responsibilities cleanly once the seller-versus-installer boundary is written down
the timeline range recorded in the expectation log is drawn directly from the partner's observed cohort cycle times
the cadence updates the homeowner against the stage sequence and the expectations the handoff recorded
the bad-news protocol is the exception path of the regular cadence and reuses its contacts, logs, and stage vocabulary
closeout continues the same contact discipline through the dark period, activation, and the first statements
the causes captured while delivering adverse news are what the taxonomy codes when a deal later dies
knowing the real cause classes is what makes the single permitted cause question useful instead of a retention manoeuvre
every deduction must be reconciled to a named trigger clause, which only exists if the agreement was mapped first
the gate's conditions are exactly the closeout artifacts - activation, monitoring, punch-list closure, first-statement review
no referral request may be made until the gate has been cleared for that job
review requests draw from the same gate-cleared population, which is what keeps solicitation ungated by expected sentiment
the ledger measures the introductions the request practice produces, so the asks must be recorded to be counted
the ledger is read per partner, so partner-level cycle time, punch lists, and complaint incidence sit beside referral yield
the accountability stance forbids the quiet handling of a price or scope change, constraining how an adder may be presented
standing with the homeowner constrains the save attempt to one non-pressuring question and immediate execution of the request
the boundary decides which elements of a complaint the seller answers for and which must be routed to the licence holder
treating reputation as the asset rules out any ask that trades a customer's trust for a short-term introduction
a thin pipeline creates pressure to ask for introductions while jobs are still unfinished, which is exactly what the gate prohibits
edges.resolution_rule: the gate wins: no campaign, sequence, or incentive runs against a job that has not cleared the conditions, and only introductions the homeowner volunteers unprompted may be accepted early, with the referred party told plainly that the referrer's system is not yet energized

edges.why_related: honouring a cancellation immediately triggers the seller's own chargeback exposure, creating a direct incentive to slow the request down
edges.resolution_rule: the homeowner's cancellation right wins absolutely and is executed the same day; chargeback exposure is managed upstream through pipeline depth and reserve planning, never by resisting, delaying, or re-pitching the cancellation

edges.why_related: pressing a disputed deduction risks the scheduling goodwill of the partner the seller's live jobs depend on
edges.resolution_rule: reconcile and dispute in writing on the contract's terms regardless of relationship cost, and if disputes recur or go unanswered treat that as a partner-quality signal that belongs in the scorecard and, past the stated threshold, in the exit path rather than trading silence for goodwill

edges.why_related: telling a homeowner plainly why a job stalled can collide with partner-loyalty expectations and with contract language about public statements
edges.resolution_rule: state verifiable status facts and name the gating stage and its owner without characterizing or disparaging the partner; never mislead a homeowner about cause to protect a partner, and if the agreement is read as forbidding truthful status disclosure, escalate it as a term to clarify and treat an unclarified prohibition as an exit signal

edges.why_related: a post-signature price or scope change is one of the most common causes of a signed deal dying, and how it is presented moves that outcome
unannounced delays are the most frequent precursor of a public complaint, so the quality of the delay protocol drives complaint volume
workmanship defects the pre-partnership evidence failed to detect surface later as complaints attributed to the seller
what was recorded at signature is what the first-statement walkthrough is read against, so the two bookend the job
the cadence runs the job to the point where the gate's conditions can even be assessed
measured outcomes per partner re-weight the criteria that actually predicted advocacy, cancellations, and complaints
scorecard drift past the stated thresholds is what triggers a submission slowdown or the exit path
recurring cancellation causes rewrite what the handoff packet must screen for and what the expectation log must state
complaint disposition and its attribution feed back as a partner measure rather than being closed and forgotten
both convert a verified-happy outcome into social proof and share the same disclosure, opt-out, and no-pressure rules

conflict_axes.name: closing_speed_versus_accuracy_of_the_stated_timeline
conflict_axes.description: A confident single install date closes more deals at the table, while a cohort-derived range with the gating stage named survives the permit queue and the utility wait that actually govern the job.
poles: state the timeline that closes
state the range the partner's own job records support
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state the range with the gating stage and the stages nobody controls named, put it in the expectation log, and accept the deals lost to a competitor's confident date as the cost of not creating delay-driven cancellations and complaints

conflict_axes.name: best_paying_partner_versus_best_building_partner
conflict_axes.description: The installer offering the richest commercial terms is frequently not the one whose crews, punch-list closure, and service responsiveness protect the seller's name.
poles: maximize pay per deal
maximize build quality and schedule reliability
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: score both in one weighted model set before recruiting conversations, and treat unverifiable licensing, abandoned punch lists, or refusal of past-customer access as disqualifiers that no pay term can outrank

conflict_axes.name: saving_the_deal_versus_honouring_the_cancellation
conflict_axes.description: Every cancellation reverses commission, which creates a standing incentive to slow, question, or re-pitch a homeowner who has already decided.
poles: work the cancellation as an objection
execute the cancellation as an instruction
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: execute immediately with one optional non-pressuring cause question, and manage the money consequence upstream through pipeline depth and reserve planning rather than through resistance

conflict_axes.name: single_partner_depth_versus_multi_partner_resilience
conflict_axes.description: Concentrating pipeline with one installer buys scheduling attention and standing; spreading it buys survivability and job-fit routing but thins standing everywhere and multiplies contractual constraints.
poles: concentrate for depth and priority
spread for resilience and fit
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: set the concentration position deliberately against the continuity read and the exclusivity clauses, and revisit it whenever the scorecard or the continuity signals move rather than drifting into concentration by habit

conflict_axes.name: owning_the_relationship_versus_staying_in_lane
conflict_axes.description: The homeowner wants the person they trusted to answer everything, while licensing and warranty realities mean many answers must come from the installer.
poles: answer the homeowner directly
route every technical question to the licence holder
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: own the communication, the escalation, and the follow-through absolutely while routing every technical, code, and warranty question as a written ticket with a named owner and a callback commitment the seller then chases

conflict_axes.name: candour_about_cause_versus_partner_loyalty
conflict_axes.description: Telling a homeowner plainly which stage stalled and who owns it can embarrass the partner whose scheduling goodwill the seller's live jobs depend on.
poles: tell the homeowner the full cause
protect the partner relationship
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state verifiable status facts and stage ownership without characterization or disparagement, never mislead the homeowner to shield a partner, and move any pattern into the scorecard conversation instead of into the customer conversation

conflict_axes.name: referral_volume_versus_customer_goodwill
conflict_axes.description: Asking earlier and more often lifts short-term introductions while spending the goodwill that produces introductions for years.
poles: ask early and often
ask once, after verified completion
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: gate every ask on the verified-happy conditions, make it once per occasion with an honoured opt-out, and measure yield by cohort so the slower practice can be defended with the ledger rather than with conviction

conflict_axes.name: incentivised_advocacy_versus_disclosure_obligations
conflict_axes.description: Paying for introductions and rewarding reviews raises volume but engages compensation-disclosure and platform rules and can quietly convert an honest advocate into an undisclosed salesperson.
poles: incentivise advocacy for volume
keep advocacy unpaid and plainly voluntary
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: if compensation is used at all, disclose it to both the referrer and the referred party before any appointment in the form the applicable obligation class requires for the jurisdiction and platform, verify that form currently, and never attach any incentive to the content or rating of a review

conflict_axes.name: absorbing_the_adder_versus_re_disclosing_and_repricing
conflict_axes.description: A post-survey adder can be handled quietly to preserve a fragile signed deal or re-disclosed in writing with a genuine option to stop.
poles: handle the change quietly to keep the deal
re-disclose in writing and re-open the decision
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: always re-disclose in writing with the revised total, the payment consequence, the option to stop, and any applicable cancellation right stated with its current jurisdictional form verified, accepting the deals that stop as the price of never owning a misrepresentation complaint

conflict_axes.name: job_level_urgency_versus_partner_level_evidence
conflict_axes.description: Each stalled job demands escalation now, while the pattern across jobs is what actually decides whether the partner should keep receiving submissions.
poles: fight every job individually
let the record accumulate and decide at review
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: escalate every job in writing on its own merits and simultaneously log it to the scorecard, so partner-level decisions rest on the accumulated record while no individual homeowner waits for a review cycle

edge_cases.description: A job sits at the permit stage in one municipality far longer than the partner's cohort suggested, with no visible activity and no explanation from the coordinator
edge_cases.trigger: a jurisdictional queue stalls a job past the range the seller stated
edge_cases.mitigation: name the gating stage and its owner in every update, escalate in writing on the ladder at a stated interval, give the homeowner the next verifiable checkpoint rather than a new date, and record the jurisdiction's behaviour so future ranges for that municipality reflect it

edge_cases.description: The site survey returns a main-panel upgrade and a roof repair that together change the total materially, and the homeowner has already told friends the original number
edge_cases.trigger: site conditions produce adders after signature
edge_cases.mitigation: re-disclose in writing with the revised total and payment consequence, restate the option to stop and any applicable cancellation right with its current jurisdictional form verified, obtain a documented fresh decision before work proceeds, and code the outcome either way

edge_cases.description: A homeowner calls the seller about water staining near a mount and wants to know whether the roof was penetrated correctly
edge_cases.trigger: a technical or code question arrives at the seller rather than the installer
edge_cases.mitigation: open a written service ticket the same day with a named installer owner and a callback commitment, tell the homeowner exactly who will contact them and when, offer no diagnosis or reassurance about cause, and chase the ticket to documented closure

edge_cases.description: Commission statements start arriving late, older service tickets stop closing, and two coordinators leave within a month
edge_cases.trigger: installer distress signals accumulate while the seller has in-flight deals
edge_cases.mitigation: slow or stop new submissions, reconcile every outstanding milestone in writing, ask in writing where the workmanship warranty obligation sits on a transfer or wind-down, prepare the factual notice for in-flight homeowners, and activate the pre-written exit path rather than waiting for an announcement

edge_cases.description: A homeowner sends a cancellation message late in the evening, days before the install crew is scheduled and after equipment has been staged
edge_cases.trigger: a cancellation lands at the most expensive possible moment for everyone
edge_cases.mitigation: acknowledge in writing the same day and route it through the contract's stated cancellation channel immediately, ask at most one non-pressuring question about cause, notify the installer so the crew is not dispatched, and record the cause with its evidence sentence

edge_cases.description: An angry public review appears while the job is still mid-process, naming the seller and describing the wait
edge_cases.trigger: a live job's frustration becomes public before it can be resolved privately
edge_cases.mitigation: respond promptly and civilly without any private customer detail, state what is being done rather than arguing the facts publicly, move the substance to a private channel, resolve the underlying stall, and never condition a remedy on the review being removed or edited

edge_cases.description: A customer whose system is installed but not yet activated volunteers to introduce a neighbour who has been asking about the panels
edge_cases.trigger: an introduction arrives before the job has cleared the verified-happy gate
edge_cases.mitigation: accept the volunteered introduction graciously, run no campaign or incentive against the unfinished job, tell the referred neighbour plainly that the referrer's system is not yet energized so their view is about the process so far, and finish the original job before any further ask

edge_cases.description: A statement shows a deduction with a code that matches no trigger in the clause map and no identifiable job
edge_cases.trigger: an unexplained offset appears on a commission statement
edge_cases.mitigation: request the deal-level backup in writing, reconcile against the milestone map and the job records, dispute inside the contractual window with evidence attached if no trigger fits, and log the event to the partner scorecard whether or not it is reversed

edge_cases.description: Two installers each claim the same homeowner as their registered lead after the homeowner spoke to a door canvasser months earlier
edge_cases.trigger: a lead-ownership collision surfaces after the seller has invested in the relationship
edge_cases.mitigation: tell the homeowner plainly what is happening and who they would be contracting with, apply the lead-ownership clause as written rather than by argument, withdraw the duplicate submission, and never let the homeowner be pitched twice as leverage in a dealer dispute

edge_cases.description: Panels are on the roof for weeks awaiting utility activation while the homeowner pays a full utility bill and a financed payment obligation has begun on its own schedule
edge_cases.trigger: the gap between install completion and permission to operate stretches
edge_cases.mitigation: pre-frame this gap at the table and again at install, give factual status on the interconnection stage at a stated interval, direct billing-mechanics questions to the lender or funder and activation questions to the installer, and never characterize the wait as anyone's fault without evidence

edge_cases.description: A customer who gave a glowing review two years ago reports a leak, and the installer's service queue is slow to respond
edge_cases.trigger: a warranty issue surfaces long after the commission was earned and spent
edge_cases.mitigation: open the warranty ticket with the installer, escalate on the ladder in writing at stated intervals, keep the homeowner updated personally even though no further commission exists, be honest that the repair obligation sits with the licence holder, and record the partner's service behaviour on the scorecard

edge_cases.description: A partner offers a temporary bonus tied to submission volume before a month-end cutoff
edge_cases.trigger: a volume incentive arrives while the seller's pipeline is thin
edge_cases.mitigation: submit exactly the deals that would have been submitted anyway, note that a bonus never changes qualification or disclosure practice, and check afterwards whether cancellation causes cluster in the incentive window as evidence of drift

workflow.action: Write the reputation stance and open the install ledger
workflow.description: State in writing that referred pipeline is the only compounding asset in this model, and create the ledger where every signed deal, its state, its installer, and its outcome will live
workflow.artifact: reputation operating principle plus an install ledger with one row per signed deal
workflow.gate: the ledger exists with its fields defined and at least one written rule naming what the business will not do for a commission

workflow.action: Fix the responsibility boundary with the licence holder
workflow.description: Assign each class of homeowner question and each obligation to seller or installer, and define the ticket-with-owner-and-callback routing pattern
workflow.artifact: responsibility split sheet with routing actions
workflow.gate: every question class - technical, code, warranty, schedule, billing, representation - has an owner and a routing action written down

workflow.action: Build the weighted partner criteria model with its disqualifiers
workflow.description: Set the criteria and weights before any recruiting conversation, and write the hard disqualifier list separately
workflow.artifact: weighted criteria model and disqualifier list
workflow.gate: weights are fixed before the first recruiting meeting and every criterion names the evidence that would score it

workflow.action: Gather first-hand build-quality evidence on each candidate
workflow.description: Visit finished installs across more than one crew, review inspection and re-inspection history and punch-list closure practice, and speak to past customers found outside the installer's list
workflow.artifact: dated candidate evidence file per installer
workflow.gate: each candidate file contains dated site observations from more than one job and at least one past-customer conversation the installer did not arrange

workflow.action: Read the backlog and cohort cycle times in the seller's own market
workflow.description: Obtain stage dates for recently completed jobs, identify the slowest gating stage and the spread, and attribute each stage to installer, jurisdiction, or utility
workflow.artifact: stage-dated cohort table with the gating stage identified
workflow.gate: the timeline range the seller intends to state is traceable to the cohort spread and names the stages nobody controls

workflow.action: Map the agreement clause by clause and run the continuity read
workflow.description: Map payment milestones and their documentary triggers, chargeback triggers and lookbacks, lead ownership, territory, termination, and in-flight treatment, alongside the observable stability signals for the partner
workflow.artifact: clause map plus dated continuity read
workflow.gate: every payment milestone and chargeback trigger is quoted from the executed agreement, and the location of the workmanship warranty obligation on a wind-down is answered in writing

workflow.action: Set the concentration position and write the exit path
workflow.description: Decide how much pipeline any one partner carries, define the routing rule if more than one is carried, and pre-write what happens to in-flight deals, unpaid milestones, and past customers on an exit
workflow.artifact: concentration position and exit path document
workflow.gate: the exit path names the treatment of in-flight deals by stage and the message past customers will receive, and exclusivity clauses have been checked against the routing rule

workflow.action: Assemble the handoff packet and the dated expectation record at signature
workflow.description: Transfer everything the installer needs to run the job without re-interviewing the homeowner, and log what the homeowner was told including the range, the stage sequence, and the dark period before activation
workflow.artifact: per-deal handoff packet and dated expectation log
workflow.gate: both exist before the first installer contact and the logged timeline language matches the cohort-derived range

workflow.action: Run the milestone communication cadence through the silent weeks
workflow.description: Update at every stage transition, run the deliberate no-change check-in, state only installer-supported status, and log every contact and commitment
workflow.artifact: per-deal contact log keyed to stage transitions
workflow.gate: no in-flight job shows a contact gap longer than the stated interval and no communicated date lacks an installer record behind it

workflow.action: Close the job out through activation and the first statements
workflow.description: Pursue the punch list to documented closure, narrate the wait to permission to operate, walk the homeowner through monitoring, and read the first post-activation statements with them against what was modelled
workflow.artifact: job closeout record with punch-list closure, activation date, monitoring walkthrough, and first-statement review
workflow.gate: the closeout record is complete and any modelled-versus-observed production gap has been routed to the installer with a ticket reference

workflow.action: Apply the verified-happy gate before any advocacy request
workflow.description: Flag eligibility from ledger evidence only - activated, producing, punch list closed, first statement walked, no open ticket or complaint, no opt-out - and redirect unfinished jobs to work rather than to an ask
workflow.artifact: eligibility flag with evidence dates on each ledger row
workflow.gate: every referral or review request in the period is traceable to a job that had cleared the gate before the request was sent

workflow.action: Read the reputation ledger and run the partner review
workflow.description: Refresh source tags, track completed-install cohorts into later introductions and installed deals, and read it beside cancellation causes, complaints, reviews, and the partner scorecard to decide the next period's partner mix
workflow.artifact: cohort referral-yield view and per-partner review outcome
workflow.gate: every opportunity carries a source tag set at creation and each partner review closes with a written requested change and its consequence

dominance_rules.rule: A homeowner's cancellation instruction dominates every save attempt and every commission consequence
dominance_rules.rationale: obstructing or slowing a cancellation is the conduct that has damaged this vertical's standing most, and the money at stake is exactly the incentive that makes a written rule necessary
dominance_rules.trigger: a homeowner states an intention to cancel in any channel
dominance_rules.action: acknowledge in writing the same day, route it into the contract's stated cancellation channel immediately, ask at most one non-pressuring question about cause, and stop entirely if the decision is repeated

dominance_rules.rule: Verified status dominates optimistic timeline talk
dominance_rules.rationale: a date the installer has not committed in writing is a promise the seller cannot keep and a cancellation the seller will later own
dominance_rules.trigger: any moment a date or duration is about to be stated to a homeowner
dominance_rules.action: state the cohort-derived range with the gating stage named, or state the next verifiable checkpoint, and never repeat a date that exists only in a verbal remark

dominance_rules.rule: The licence holder's scope dominates the seller's willingness to be helpful
dominance_rules.rationale: an unlicensed opinion on workmanship, code, or warranty can mislead a homeowner and jeopardize their claim
dominance_rules.trigger: a technical, code, structural, electrical, or warranty question reaches the seller
dominance_rules.action: route it as a written ticket with a named owner and a callback commitment, then chase it to closure instead of answering it

dominance_rules.rule: Re-disclosure dominates deal preservation whenever price, scope, or equipment changes after signature
dominance_rules.rationale: a change the homeowner discovers later is the raw material of a misrepresentation complaint, and quietly absorbing it hides a decision that belongs to them
dominance_rules.trigger: any adder, redesign, equipment substitution, or payment-structure change after signature
dominance_rules.action: re-disclose in writing with the revised total, the payment consequence, and the option to stop, restate any applicable cancellation right with its current jurisdictional form verified, and obtain a documented fresh decision before work proceeds

dominance_rules.rule: The written agreement dominates any verbal assurance about pay, chargebacks, territory, or termination
dominance_rules.rationale: recruiting conversations are not terms, and every deduction will be adjudicated against the executed document
dominance_rules.trigger: a recruiter or coordinator asserts a practice that the agreement does not contain
dominance_rules.action: ask for it in the document or an executed addendum, and plan on the written term until it is amended

dominance_rules.rule: The contemporaneous written record dominates anyone's recollection
dominance_rules.rationale: expectation logs, contact logs, disclosures, tickets, and statements are what resolve disputes and chargebacks, and memory reliably favours whoever is speaking
dominance_rules.trigger: any dispute, complaint, chargeback, or contested account of what was promised
dominance_rules.action: reconstruct from the record first, answer from it, and correct the record honestly where it shows the seller was wrong

dominance_rules.rationale: the seller's name is on the introduction, so a partner that damages homes, abandons punch lists, or leaves warranty claims unanswered is destroying the only compounding asset the business has
dominance_rules.trigger: a pattern of defects, abandoned punch items, or unanswered service tickets appears on the scorecard
dominance_rules.action: escalate in writing with the evidence, slow submissions at the stated threshold, and activate the exit path rather than continuing to sell into it

dominance_rules.rule: The verified-happy gate dominates pipeline hunger
dominance_rules.rationale: asking an unfinished customer for advocacy converts a recoverable job into a public complaint and spends trust that has not been earned
dominance_rules.trigger: a thin pipeline or a monthly target creates pressure to run a referral or review campaign
dominance_rules.action: run the ask only against gate-cleared jobs and spend the impulse on finishing the jobs that failed a condition

dominance_rules.rule: Jurisdiction and platform rules dominate any incentive idea for referrals or reviews
dominance_rules.rationale: compensation disclosure and review-solicitation rules are obligation classes that differ by place and platform, and a violation costs more than the volume the incentive buys
dominance_rules.trigger: any proposal to pay for introductions, reward reviews, or promote customer advocacy
dominance_rules.action: identify the applicable obligation class, verify its current form with the authority or platform, disclose to both sides before any appointment, and drop the idea if the verification cannot be completed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Complete build-quality and cohort cycle-time evidence before selling the first deal under a new partner
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an entire first cohort of homeowners receiving promises the partner cannot keep, which must then be re-sold, rescued, or refunded

anti_rework_rules.rule: Map the payment milestones and chargeback triggers before counting any commission as earned
anti_rework_rules.prevents: planning and spending against money that a lookback clause reverses, and arguing a deduction from memory months later

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record what the homeowner was told at the table before the file reaches the installer
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unresolvable disputes months later where the only evidence is two contradictory recollections

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set the stated timeline from the observed cohort spread rather than the best case
anti_rework_rules.prevents: delay-driven cancellations and rescue conversations on jobs that were always going to take the ordinary amount of time

anti_rework_rules.rule: Agree the escalation ladder, its named contacts, and the expected response behaviour before the first job is submitted
anti_rework_rules.prevents: improvising an escalation during the first crisis while a homeowner waits and the relationship decays

anti_rework_rules.rule: Screen for the common adder classes before signature wherever the site allows it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a post-survey re-disclosure that reopens the whole decision and kills deals that could have been priced correctly the first time

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the exit path and the in-flight treatment before signing the partner agreement
anti_rework_rules.prevents: stranded deals, unpaid milestones, and past customers with nowhere to take a warranty claim when a partnership ends

anti_rework_rules.rule: Code every cancellation with its cause and owner at the moment it happens
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unattributable churn history that cannot be fixed and cannot be used in a partner conversation

anti_rework_rules.rule: Clear the verified-happy conditions before any referral or review campaign touches a customer
anti_rework_rules.prevents: converting a recoverable unfinished job into a public complaint that then has to be answered in front of every future prospect

iteration_protocol.trigger: observed cycle times drift outside the range currently being stated to homeowners
iteration_protocol.action: re-read the cohort, restate the range and the gating stage, and proactively update every in-flight homeowner whose expectation was set on the old range

iteration_protocol.trigger: coded cancellations cluster on a single cause class within a period
iteration_protocol.action: trace the cluster to the upstream practice or partner behaviour that produces it and change that practice before adding volume

iteration_protocol.trigger: a deduction appears that the clause map does not explain
iteration_protocol.action: request deal-level backup, re-read the agreement, extend the clause map, dispute inside the window with evidence, and re-reconcile prior statements for the same pattern

iteration_protocol.trigger: a public complaint, negative review, or consumer-protection inquiry lands
iteration_protocol.action: run the complaint sequence from the reconstructed record, route each element to its owner, fix the underlying cause, and log the disposition to the partner scorecard

iteration_protocol.trigger: installer continuity signals deteriorate - late payments, staffing churn, aging service tickets, funding or ownership change
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the continuity read, slow or stop submissions, confirm in writing where warranty obligations sit, and activate the exit path if the signals persist

iteration_protocol.trigger: a jurisdiction, regulator, or platform changes the rules attaching to cancellation windows, referral compensation disclosure, or review solicitation
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the obligation class with the issuing authority or platform, update the scripts, disclosures, and request practice, and record the verification date

iteration_protocol.trigger: the referred share of installed deals falls across consecutive periods
iteration_protocol.action: audit the gate conditions, the ask practice, and the closeout quality of the cohorts that produced the decline before spending on paid acquisition to compensate

iteration_protocol.trigger: the scheduled partner review cycle arrives
iteration_protocol.action: refresh every scorecard measure from the seller's own job records, hold the joint review with the evidence shown, and record the requested change, its consequence, and any change to the concentration position

priority_rationale: The frame nodes come first because reputation as the only compounding asset, the seller's continuing accountability after signature, and the boundary with the licensed installer determine every later choice; partner diligence follows because build quality, backlog behaviour, continuity risk, and the agreement's payment and chargeback clauses are settled before a single homeowner is exposed to that partner; handoff operations then run the signed deal - packet and expectation record, milestone cadence, delay and change-order protocols, and closeout through activation and the first statements; cancellation management sits after those because causes can only be coded and chargebacks only reconciled once the job history and the clause map exist; and the reputation engine comes last because the verified-happy gate, the referral and review practice, complaint handling, and the yield ledger are all functions of jobs that were finished properly first.
